name: oort
description: Long-term memory for Claude: recall facts you chose to keep, remember decisions and preferences, forget on request.
long_description: Oort keeps facts across conversations on your own computer: decisions, preferences and project details. Claude can recall them, save new ones you state or confirm, explain why a memory exists, and forget it permanently. Memories stay on this machine. Use your own Voyage, TypeSafe and Anthropic keys, or an Oort Pro key so you need none.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Search saved memories for facts relevant to a question.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Save one to five facts the user stated or confirmed.

tools.name: pin
tools.description: Keep a memory always available, or release it.

tools.name: explain
tools.description: Show why a memory was stored and what it replaced.

tools.name: list_recent
tools.description: List recently saved or changed memories.

tools.name: record_judgment
tools.description: Record a decision an expert made, with their reason.

tools.name: judge
tools.description: Predict an expert's verdict on a new item from their judgments.

oort_home.title: Memory folder
oort_home.description: Where Oort keeps your memories. Share it with the oort command line by keeping the default.

oort_api_key.title: Oort Pro key (optional)
oort_api_key.description: With Oort Pro you need no other keys. Create one at oortcloud.dev/account.

voyage_api_key.title: Voyage AI key (optional)
voyage_api_key.description: For search by meaning. Leave empty to use Oort Pro, or keyword search only.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe key (optional)
typesafe_api_key.description: For deciding what to keep when saving. Leave empty to use Oort Pro.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic key (optional)
anthropic_api_key.description: For writing saved facts. Leave empty to use Oort Pro.
